premises.text: Makers Hub enables customers to connect disparate accounts payable processes and capture all data with no manual entry
premises.evidence_span: Makers Hub provides data-enriched accounts payable operations. We enable our customers to connect their disparate account payable processes, to capture all of their data with no manual entry

premises.text: Businesses struggle with validating bills and coding line items due to complexity and disconnection among functions
premises.evidence_span: First, the right person or group of people needs to validate that the bill is valid. Is this what we ordered? Did we receive it in full? Are there any payment terms to consider? Is the pricing correct? Next, every line item on the bill needs to be coded to the appropriate customer, job, and accounting code.

premises.text: Makers Hub's technology extracts over 50,000 data points from bills to facilitate processing
premises.evidence_span: we extract more than 50,000 data points from every page, the characters and their relation to one another

premises.text: Makers Hub uses deterministic language models to reconcile data from bills
premises.evidence_span: expose that partially reconciled data to a series of deterministic language models that help us put a finer point on that reconciliation

premises.text: Users can approve bills and create associated records in the accounting system with a single click
premises.evidence_span: a single click approves the bill, auto-creates the associated record in the accounting system

premises.text: Makers Hub provides a fully integrated system that enhances visibility and efficiency in accounts payable processes
premises.evidence_span: The value of being a fully integrated system is that we can push this contextual data thread all the way through the process

value.text: Makers Hub improves efficiency and confidence in financial operations for businesses
value.evidence_span: The result for Trey is a more efficient workforce, better data for the organization, and greater confidence in his financial operations

notes: Customer count, fundraising, and demo offer excluded as traction.
